punchline: In Thich Nhat Hanh's sheet of paper there is a cloud, a logger and the logger's bread.
thirty_sec: Thich Nhat Hanh asks you to look at a sheet of paper. No cloud, no rain, no tree, no paper. Keep looking and you find the sunshine, the logger, the wheat that became his bread, even his parents. Take any of them away and the paper is gone. He uses the same look on someone who speaks badly to you: they may have been spoken to just that way the day before. First you take care of your own anger, then you act.
